tiers.everyday: The Netherlands Carillon was a thank-you gift from the Dutch people for American help in World War II. Its tower near Arlington was dedicated in 1960.
tiers.student: NPS: a silver bell presented by Queen Juliana on 4 April 1952; 49 bells arrived in 1954 and played from a temporary tower; the tower (about 127 ft, by Joost Boks) was dedicated on 5 May 1960. Later changes to the bell count [UNKNOWN] in the cited page.
